ticket: 05 of .scratch/overhaul-2026-11/issues/05-dn-record-chain-expand.md, acceptance box 'code-review run since the base commit, with no gaps on the spec axis.'
authority: Operator, in session 2026-11-11. Recorded under CLAUDE.md §9.4. Closes no gate, adds no runtime gate and amends no constitutional rule.
decision: Ticket 05 closes with one accepted limitation: a comparison record binds its revisions artifact by path only. Four behaviour changes made by the ticket are accepted.

rules.rule: A comparison record stores the path of its revisions artifact and no hash of it. A written diff stores that hash, so loading a written diff refuses an edited revisions artifact. A new diff run checks only the hashes the comparison binds, so it does not detect an edit to the revisions artifact. This limitation is accepted for the O5 bundle.
rules.basis: Operator decision in session, 2026-11-11 (option 1). The three committed comparisons under docs/tier4_orchestration_state/msca_dn/comparisons/ carry revisions_artifact paths only. Ticket 05 forbids record-format changes.

rules.rule: Adding a revisions hash to the comparison record is a later format ticket. It lands after V16, so the bundle frozen at O5 serves V14 and V16 unchanged.
rules.basis: Operator decision in session, 2026-11-11. D2 of plan-order-reliability_2026-11-11: nothing lands in the bundle between V14 and V16.

rules.rule: load_comparison without a repo root resolves a relative predecessor path first against the nearest folder above the record that contains it, then against the harness repository.
Loading a comparison re-hashes its dispositions, fidelity register and audits, as well as its baseline report and ESR record. Every committed comparison still loads.
rules.basis: Operator acceptance in session, 2026-11-11. Tests load and replay the committed comparisons.

rules.rule: A revisions artifact without advisory=true and blocking=false is refused. All three committed revisions artifacts carry both flags.
Comparison writes use the temp-file prefix comparison_ instead of esr_comparison_. The written bytes are unchanged.

known_gaps.gap: G1's limitation stays open until the later format ticket of G2 lands.
